priorityList: Use Potion and Power Infusion during Dragonrage for maximum burst windows.
Cast Dragonrage as your primary cooldown, ensuring targets will live for at least 15 seconds.
Use Tip the Scales during Dragonrage, prioritizing it for an instant Eternity Surge or Fire Breath.
Cast Fire Breath at Empower Level 1 to apply its damage-over-time effect, especially if the DoT is missing or refreshable.
Cast Eternity Surge at Empower Level 1 if Dragonrage is active or Mass Disintegrate is talented.
When Dragonrage is not active, empower Eternity Surge to match the number of targets (Level 2 for 2 targets, Level 3 for 3, etc.).
Use Deep Breath if Imminent Destruction is talented and Fire Breath's DoT is not currently active on targets.
If Mass Disintegrate is talented, use Disintegrate as your primary Essence spender whenever the Mass Disintegrate buff is active.
Cast Pyre as your primary Essence spender when facing 4 or more enemies, or 3 enemies if Volatility or Feed the Flames is talented.
Spend Essence on Pyre regardless of target count if Charged Blast stacks reach 12 or more.
Cast Living Flame when Leaping Flames is active (after Fire Breath) or when Burnout procs.
Use Azure Sweep as your primary filler and Essence generator in AoE situations.
Use Azure Strike only as a last-resort filler during movement if Hover is unavailable.
Activate offensive trinkets during Dragonrage, ideally when Rising Fury stacks are high or Tip the Scales is ready.
Use Hover to maintain casting uptime during movement-heavy phases.
